doc.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997

title: Closing the main talk and Gleason as godfather
summary: Palmer was at Gleason's wedding and Gleason and Genevieve christened Palmer's son.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: That’s so we don’t miss a word. Well this has been a fascinating time, Jack.
Well thank you. Thank you for asking me. It is very refreshing for me, like to reminisce a little bit.
And I learned yesterday that Jackie Gleason is your son’s Godfather?
Yeah. Well I stood up for Gleason’s wedding, this is how that happened. And then he and Genevieve christened my son. Genevieve was Gleason’s wife.
